clause: Vector live-effect evaluation path + vector Stylize [STU-FX-027,STU-FX-020a]

scope.summary: Implement the vector live-effect evaluation path: StudioLiveFilter kinds operating on the live StudioVectorPath/StudioVectorNetwork geometry inside the effect stack, re-evaluated on geometry/parameter change, expandable to real geometry on explicit EFFECT_BAKE. Raster-group vector effects (artistic/blur applied to vector art) render through the document raster-effect resolution setting and REUSE the group-10 catalog (no redefinition). Vector Stylize = the round-corners + scribble native-vector kinds plus the shadow/glow/feather layer-fx reused from MT-287/288 evaluated on live geometry (NOT the raster Stylize family of MT-275).
acceptance_criteria: vector live-effect eval on live geometry + EFFECT_BAKE expand; Stylize = round corners/scribble/shadow/glow/feather reused; raster-on-vector reuses group-10
expected_tests: test: effect re-evaluates on geometry edit; EFFECT_BAKE expands to real geometry; raster-on-vector uses doc raster-effect resolution
test: vector Stylize reuses layer-fx kinds (no fork of raster Stylize)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Vector effects pre-rasterize / fork; live-geometry re-eval + bake-expand missing.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
